sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Hartland's five selectboard members as Phil Hobbie, Clyde Jenne, Thomas Kennedy, James Rielly, and Trace Tancreti. Hartland's own town website was unreachable from every path tried, so this roster rests on the Secretary of State's directories (the Bloomfield posture).

jp_election.name: Town of Hartland Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the twelve Hartland winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election; John Bartholomew is the sitting Windsor-1 state representative -- his legislature biography lists his Hartland justice of the peace seat -- and his existing person record is reused. No constable post is created (the seat count is a per-town vote, unverifiable here) and no delinquent-tax-collector post (the treasurer holds the function by default).
